record.name: Balgass Barracks
record.description: Kundun commanded Lemuria, the Queen of Sorcery, to dispatch troops to Crywolf in attempt to overcome guardians of the continent. Lemuria assigned Balgass, a great warlord, to build an army and attack the city relentlessly. Quickly, Balgass established a training ground for monsters, called Balgass' Barracks, in the eastern caves of Crywolf. Its here that his army is continuously training and preparing for their attacks on the city.
quick_facts: Requires completing the Evidence of Strength quest to enter.
Not a recommended map for EXP gain.

boss: You can enter Balgass Resting Place from this map.
Balgass Resting Place is entered during the Into The Realm of 'Darkness' quest.
This map can only be entered the quest is active.
The boss monster, Dark Elf (Trainee Soldier), is located inside Balgass Resting Place.
After completing the quest you cannot enter Balgass Resting Place again.

notes: You cannot warp to this map.

You can only exit this map via warp.
